Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) shows the classic "scimitar sign" on the right side, where an anomalous vein runs parallel to the right heart border, accompanied by mediastinal deviation to the right and a hypoplastic right lung. The CT images confirm the presence of an abnormal systemic artery supplying the inferior right lung (indicated by the arrow in Figure 1), which is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome.
